reader_summary.overview: We are delighted to share with you our audio program on Charlie Munger. Each program in the series is an hour-long narrated profile of one investor, drawn from the investor’s own letters, talks and meetings. We make these programs so that members can learn how a great investor thinks and works.

key_points.text: We are delighted to share with you our audio program on Charlie Munger.
We make these programs so that members can learn how a great investor thinks and works.
Your feedback on what was useful, and on which investors to cover next, shapes what we produce.
